answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 183138 Country: United Kingdom Title: Food is halal or not Question: I am a Masters student in Taiwan, I want to ask you that in our university cafeteria there are haram restaurant along with a halal authorized restaurant (certified by Chinese Muslim Association). Recently I have noticed that the plates, spoon and chopsticks are washed in a common dishwasher where haram plates, spoon are also washed. •Is it permissible to consume food in that common washed plate • What is procedure to paak a steel plate and crockery. Answer ID: 183138 Posted on: Oct 31, 2021 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 303/243/B=3/1443) If water accumulates in a normal dishwasher and both clean and unclean plates are washed in it, then all those plates become napak (impure). It is not permissible for Muslims to eat in such a plate, and if they wash it separately with the pressure of tap, i.e., they wash it with clean water, then those plates are pure. You can eat halal food in it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
